description: This is a frontend HTML file that provides a web interface for visualizing databases and their tables. It includes UI components like a sidebar listing databases and tables, and a main content area displaying data in tabular form. The script handles fetching database, table, and data information via API calls, and renders the data dynamically, supporting features like expandable cells and UI interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Retrieves and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts an HTML table from fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell with appropriate formatting and expandability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content for full view.
